assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.emptyTitle: Ask me anything about your store
assistant.intro: I tell you how to do something and show you the screen. I only answer; I never change anything in your store.

suggestions.s1: How do I connect a domain to my store?
suggestions.s3: How do I add a new product?

assistant.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line
assistant.tooLong: The message is too long (over 2000 characters). Please shorten it.
assistant.error: I could not answer just now. Please try again in a moment.
assistant.off: The assistant is not turned on for your store right now. It appears by itself when it is.
assistant.thanks: Thank you, we got your feedback.

card.label: Proposed change
card.applied: Done. You can undo it for 24 hours.
card.appliedNoUndo: Done. The undo window has ended.
card.undone: I put it back the way it was.
card.stale: The data changed, this is the new version. Review it before you apply.
card.untrusted: This text came from a customer or from a source outside your store.
card.suggestionMode: The assistant is in suggestion mode: it prepares the preview but does not apply. Applying opens later.
card.needsConfirm: This change needs your explicit confirmation before it is applied.

failed.forbidden: Your role does not allow this change. Ask the store owner.
failed.expired: This preview expired. Ask the assistant to prepare it again.
failed.killed: The assistant is paused right now. Nothing was changed.
failed.error: I could not apply it. Nothing was changed, try again.

assistant.introDo: I tell you how to do something, show you the screen and prepare the change as a preview. You review and apply it, and you can undo it.

confirm.label: A change that needs your confirmation
confirm.irreversible: You will not be able to undo this once it is done.
confirm.appliedFinal: Done. This change cannot be undone.
confirm.noToken: This confirmation is no longer available (the page was refreshed or it timed out). Ask the assistant to prepare it again.

failed.forbidden: Your role no longer allows this change. Nothing was changed.
failed.expired: This confirmation expired (15 minutes). Ask the assistant to prepare it again.
failed.used: This confirmation was already used or is no longer valid. Nothing was changed.
failed.killed: The assistant is paused right now. Nothing was changed.
failed.error: I could not apply it. Nothing was changed, try again.
